title: Skip Atwater's contact in Australia sees UFOs going in and out of Mount Zeil

tellings.quote: It's the most boring job I've ever had if it weren't for all those UFOs going in and out of Mount Zeal would have anything to do.

plain: A man working in Australia near Mount Zeil, a mountain in the centre of the country, is said to have called it the most boring job he ever had, if it weren't for all the UFOs going in and out of the mountain. The former Army sergeant Lyn Buchanan tells this second-hand, as something passed on by his associate Skip Atwater about a contact of his, suggesting the mountain may hold some kind of base.
